data.show_unknown_zero: Show zero when inverter is offline (e.g. night / micro-inverters)

data_description.deviceSN: The serial number of this inverter.
data_description.energyGeneratedSanityCheck: Maximum expected daily energy generation in kWh. Readings above this threshold are ignored to protect Energy Dashboard statistics from corrupted spikes (default: 100 kWh).
data_description.reduceAPICalls: Halves API polling frequency (10-minute intervals) to prevent exceeding the FoxESS 1,440 daily call quota, especially useful for multi-inverter setups or accounts linked to VPP providers.
data_description.show_unknown_zero: When enabled, power and current sensors report 0 instead of unavailable when the inverter is offline (such as micro-inverters at night), and cumulative energy totals are retained.
data_description.extendPV: Enable for Fox R series or inverters with more than 6 PV strings.
data_description.Evo: Enable if using a FoxESS EVO inverter where device details are incomplete.
data_description.xtZone: Enable if inverter timestamps use a different time zone than Home Assistant.
data_description.Restrict: Enable if Fox Cloud returns errors for large variable lists.
